form.label: Linux Auth Security: Failed-Login Spike & Threat Detection
form.description: Real-time visual monitoring of Linux PAM/SSHD authentication failures, brute-force spike anomaly detection, and attacker profiling.

search.query: index=os_security sourcetype=linux_secure | stats count by host

div.div: Surveillance of SSH daemon logins, PAM auth failures, and credential stuffing spikes.

search.query: index=os_security sourcetype=linux_secure action=failure host="$selected_host$" user="$user_filter$" | stats count
index=os_security sourcetype=linux_secure action=failure host="$selected_host$" user="$user_filter$" | stats dc(src_ip) as distinct_ips
index=os_security sourcetype=linux_secure action=failure host="$selected_host$" user="$user_filter$" | timechart span=15m count | stats max(count) as peak_rate

index=os_security sourcetype=linux_secure action=failure host="$selected_host$" user="$user_filter$" | eval is_invalid = if(match(_raw, "invalid user"), 1, 0) | stats sum(is_invalid) as invalid_count, count as total | eval pct = round((invalid_count/total)*100, 1) | fields pct

chart.title: Failed-Login Spikes & Anomaly Baseline (Timechart with Dynamic Threshold)

search.query: index=os_security sourcetype=linux_secure action=failure host="$selected_host$" user="$user_filter$" | timechart span=15m count as Failed_Attempts | streamstats window=8 avg(Failed_Attempts) as Baseline_Mean, stdev(Failed_Attempts) as Baseline_Stdev | eval Spike_Threshold = round(Baseline_Mean + (2.5 * Baseline_Stdev), 1) | eval Anomaly_Spike = if(Failed_Attempts > Spike_Threshold AND Failed_Attempts > 20, Failed_Attempts, null())

chart.title: Top Targeted Usernames (Valid Accounts vs. Invalid User Enumeration)

search.query: index=os_security sourcetype=linux_secure action=failure host="$selected_host$" user="$user_filter$" | eval user_type = if(match(_raw, "invalid user"), "Invalid User (Spraying)", "Valid User (Targeted)") | top limit=10 user by user_type | fields user, count, user_type

table.title: Top 10 Attacking Source IPs (Click IP to Filter Drilldown)

search.query: index=os_security sourcetype=linux_secure action=failure host="$selected_host$" user="$user_filter$" | stats count as attempts, dc(user) as targeted_users, values(user) as sample_users by src_ip | eventstats sum(attempts) as total_attempts | eval pct_of_attacks = round((attempts/total_attempts)*100, 2) . "%" | sort 10 - attempts | fields src_ip, attempts, pct_of_attacks, targeted_users, sample_users

table.title: Forensic Event Drilldown (Filtered by Selected Attacker: $selected_attacker_ip$)

search.query: index=os_security sourcetype=linux_secure action=failure host="$selected_host$" | eval attacker_filter = if(isnull("$selected_attacker_ip$") OR "$selected_attacker_ip$"="", "*", "$selected_attacker_ip$") | search src_ip=attacker_filter | eval classification = case( match(_raw, "invalid user"), "CRITICAL - ENUMERATION", match(_raw, "root"), "CRITICAL - PRIVILEGE_ATTACK", true(), "HIGH - BRUTE_FORCE" ) | table _time, classification, host, src_ip, user, _raw | sort - _time | head 100
